arxiv-2109-01877.title: Multi-State Formulation of the Frozen-Density Embedding Quasi-Diabatization Approach
arxiv-2109-01877.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by . We present a multi-state implementation of the recently developed FDE-diab methodology [ J. , 148 ( 2018 ), 214104] in the Serenity program. The new framework extends the original approach such that any number of charge-localized quasi-diabatic states can be coupled, giving an access to calculations of ground and excited state spin-density distributions as well as to excitation energies.

arxiv-2210-01256.title: And what if two musical versions don’t share melody, harmony, rhythm, or lyrics ?
arxiv-2210-01256.description: Abstract Version identification (VI) has seen substantial progress over the past few years. On the one hand, the introduction of the metric learning paradigm has favored the emergence of scalable yet accurate VI systems. On the other hand, using features focusing on specific aspects of musical pieces, such as melody, harmony, or lyrics, yielded interpretable and promising performances.

arxiv-2307-04360.title: Mean-field analysis of load balancing principles in large scale systems
arxiv-2307-04360.creator: Illés Horváth
arxiv-2307-04360.description: Abstract Load balancing plays a crucial role in many large scale systems. Several different load balancing principles have been proposed in the literature, such as Join-Shortest-Queue (JSQ) and its variations, or Join-Below-Threshold. We provide a high level mathematical framework to examine heterogeneous server clusters in the mean-field limit as the system load and the number of servers scale proportionally.

arxiv-2402-08450.title: Subgraphormer: Unifying Subgraph GNNs and Graph Transformers via Graph Products
arxiv-2402-08450.creator: Guy Bar-Shalom, Beatrice Bevilacqua, Haggai Maron
arxiv-2402-08450.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Guy Bar-Shalom, Beatrice Bevilacqua, Haggai Maron. In the realm of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), two exciting research directions have recently emerged: Subgraph GNNs and Graph Transformers. In this paper, we propose an architecture that integrates both approaches, dubbed Subgraphormer , which combines the enhanced expressive power, message-passing mechanisms, and aggregation schemes from Subgraph GNNs with attention and positional encodings, arguably the most important components in Graph Transformers.

arxiv-2410-00972.title: X-ray spectropolarimetric characterization of GX 340 + + 0 in the horizontal branch: A highly inclined source?
arxiv-2410-00972.creator: Fabio La Monaca, Alessandro Di Marco, Renee M. Ludlam, Anna Bobrikova, Juri Poutanen, Songwei Li, Fei Xie
arxiv-2410-00972.description: Abstract We report the first detection of X-ray polarization in the horizontal branch for GX 340 + + 0 as obtained by the Imaging X-ray Polarimetry Explorer (IXPE). A polarization degree of 4.3% ± \pm 0.4% at a confidence level of 68% is obtained. This value agrees with the previous polarization measurements of Z-sources in the horizontal branch.

arxiv-2501-15344.title: On refactorization problems and rational Lax matrices of quadrirational Yang–Baxter maps
arxiv-2501-15344.creator: Pavlos Kassotakis, Theodoros E. Kouloukas, Maciej Nieszporski
arxiv-2501-15344.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Pavlos Kassotakis, Theodoros E. Kouloukas, Maciej Nieszporski. We present rational Lax representations for one-component parametric quadrirational Yang–Baxter maps in both the abelian and non-abelian settings. We show that from the Lax matrices of a general class of non-abelian involutive Yang–Baxter maps ( 𝒦 \mathcal{K} -list), by considering the symmetries of the 𝒦 \mathcal{K} -list maps, we obtain compatible refactorization problems with rational Lax matrices for other classes of non-abelian involutive Yang–Baxter maps ( Λ \Lambda , ℋ \mathcal{H} and ℱ \mathcal{F} lists).

arxiv-2504-14908.title: The universality of filamentation-caused challenges of ultrafast laser energy deposition in semiconductors
arxiv-2504-14908.creator: Maxime Chambonneau, Markus Blothe, Vladimir Yu. Fedorov, Isaure de Kernier, Stelios Tzortzakis, Stefan Nolte
arxiv-2504-14908.description: Abstract Light propagation in semiconductors is the cornerstone of emerging disruptive technologies holding considerable potential to revolutionize telecommunications, sensors, quantum engineering, healthcare, and artificial intelligence. Sky-high optical nonlinearities make these materials ideal platforms for photonic integrated circuits. The fabrication of such complex devices could greatly benefit from in-volume ultrafast laser writing for monolithic and contactless integration.

arxiv-2506-11952.title: Quantum Critical Eliashberg Theory Journal: Xxxx. Xxx. Xxx. Xxx. DOI: 10.1146/((please add article doi))
arxiv-2506-11952.creator: Ilya Esterlis 1 and Jörg Schmalian 2
arxiv-2506-11952.description: Abstract Quantum criticality plays a central role in understanding non-Fermi liquid behavior and unconventional superconductivity in strongly correlated systems. In this review, we explore the quantum critical Eliashberg theory, which extends conventional Eliashberg approaches to non-Fermi liquid regimes governed by critical fluctuations.

arxiv-2512-09929.title: Closing the Train-Test Gap in World Models for Gradient-Based Planning
arxiv-2512-09929.creator: Arjun Parthasarathy, Nimit Kalra, Rohun Agrawal, Yann LeCun, Oumayma Bounou, Pavel Izmailov, Micah Goldblum
arxiv-2512-09929.description: Abstract World models paired with model predictive control (MPC) can be trained offline on large-scale datasets of expert trajectories and enable generalization to a wide range of planning tasks at inference time. Compared to traditional MPC procedures, which rely on slow search algorithms or on iteratively solving optimization problems exactly, gradient-based planning offers a computationally efficient alternative.

pmc-11326045.title: A Case Report of Wünderlich Syndrome Causing Massive Hemorrhage During Hemodialysis
pmc-11326045.creator: Karalee Bluhm, Ravali Kundeti, Nicole Maguire
pmc-11326045.description: IntroductionWünderlich syndrome (WS) refers to subcapsular, perirenal, or pararenal hemorrhage due to non-traumatic and iatrogenic conditions. Neoplasms, vascular disease, renal etiology, and anticoagulant use are underlying risk factors.Case ReportWe describe a case of WS in a 79-year-old male who was undergoing hemodialysis, which resulted in hemorrhagic shock requiring multiple transfusions and embolization by interventional radiology.

pmc-11515478.title: Use of renin-angiotensin system blockers and posttraumatic stress disorder risk in the UK Biobank: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-11515478.creator: Sunghyuk Kang, Jimin Kim, Ji Su Yang, Ye Jin Jeon, Hyeok-Hee Lee, Shakira F Suglia, Alexander C Tsai, Jee In Kang, Sun Jae Jung
pmc-11515478.description: BackgroundPrevious research has shown that the use of renin-angiotensin system (RAS) blockers is linked to a lower prevalence of posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD), but longitudinal studies are scarce. We aimed to estimate the association between the use of RAS blockers and the risk of PTSD among individuals taking antihypertensive medications.MethodsThis longitudinal study included participants aged 40–69 from the UK Biobank.

pmc-11633682.title: Efficacy and safety of stiripentol in the prevention and cessation of status epilepticus: A systematic review
pmc-11633682.creator: Nicola Specchio, Stéphane Auvin, Adam Strzelczyk, Francesco Brigo, Vicente Villanueva, Eugen Trinka
pmc-11633682.description: Status epilepticus (SE) is a life‐threatening emergency with high morbidity and mortality. In people with epilepsy, the management of SE is focused on early medical treatment. Stiripentol is a third‐generation antiseizure medication (ASM) approved for refractory generalized tonic–clonic seizures in Dravet syndrome.

pmc-12538425.title: Understanding first-line treatment patterns and survival outcomes across sociodemographic groups of women with metastatic triple-negative breast cancer in the United States: a real-world study
pmc-12538425.creator: SM Tolaney, L Spring, YG Abdou, MK Rehnquist, C Hogea, A Estrin, N Sjekloca, C Lai, K Kalinsky
pmc-12538425.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundTriple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) has poor prognosis, and disproportionately affects young black women and BRCA1/2 mutation carriers. We describe sociodemographic differences in real-world treatment patterns and survival outcomes in women with metastatic TNBC (mTNBC) in the United States.Patients and methodsThis retrospective, real-world cohort study used de-identified data from patients in the Flatiron Health database diagnosed with mTNBC who received first-line (1L) treatment between January 2018 and July 2022.

pmc-13106911.title: Single‐Cell Nanodroplet Processing Proteomics Pipeline for Analysis of Human‐Derived Microglia
pmc-13106911.creator: Ashley N Ives, James M Fulcher, Alex R Bautista, Reta Birhanu Kitata, Sarah M Williams, David A Bennett, Philip L De Jager, Vladislav A Petyuk
pmc-13106911.description: Single‐cell omics tools provide unique insights into heterogeneous cell populations and their responses to stimuli. For example, single‐cell RNA sequencing has identified several transcriptionally distinct populations of microglia, which are resident immune cells of the central nervous system (CNS) that are responsive to CNS injury, infection, and neurodegeneration.

pmc-13550989.creator: Yuyao Yi, Pengfei Shen, Tongsen Zheng, Ruigang Hou, Lianlian Fan, Yanxia Yu, Jian Li, Yu Fang, Chuan Hao, Pinghong You, Xiaoyu Lu, Xiongbing Lu, Qiang Wei, Ping Feng

pmc-13681964.description: BackgroundOxygen refers to a colorless, odorless, tasteless gas that is essential for proper body functioning and survival. Understanding patients’ and caregivers’ perceptions of oxygen therapy directly impacts healthcare practices.
